Conversion: SDHC > PC >  Audacity 3.5.1 (file join, normalize to -0.1db, fades, dithering to 16/44.1) > CD Wave (tracking) > foobar2000 (flac level 6)

Notes:
- Thanks once again to Henry Hart for the tag-team setup and taper wisdom. Always good to have another taper in the pit!
- Dave made multiple references to the humidity during the show. Yesterday's high was 94 degrees and humidity was well over 40%.. so yeah, it was pretty muggy.
- If you're going to burn to CD, suggested track splits are 1-9, 10-15, 16-20
